name: staircase
description: Indoor staircase (室内楼梯) with derived stair orientation: straight / L (转角带平台) / U (双跑折返带平台). facing = 上行方向 (the iron rule: stair facing = uphill/high side), all half=bottom, landings are solid full blocks (整砖平台, no slab seams), last step flush with the upper floor plate.
when_to_use: Any interior floor-to-floor connection. Motivation: hand-placed interior stairs are the #1 orientation failure in real builds (实测: AI 手摆室内楼梯朝向必翻车) — always run this generator instead of placing stairs by hand. origin = 底层第一级踏步格 (y = 底层地板行走面, its block sits on the floor at y-1); the script guarantees the top step surface lands exactly on 上楼板面 (origin.y+floors). DIRECTION STATES ARE DERIVED — never hand-edit facing in the output; change params and re-run (禁止手改方向状态).

origin.notes: 底层第一级踏步所在格; y = 底层地板行走面高度 (地板方块在 y-1)

facing.notes: 上行方向; 每级踏步 stair 的 facing 都由它推导 (facing=高侧/上行)

shape.notes: straight=直跑; l=90°转角带 W×W 整砖平台 (固定向左转, 用 origin/facing 选位); u=180°折返带 1×2W 整砖平台

width.notes: 并排踏步数, 向 facing 右手边展开

floors.notes: 爬升总高(格) = 层净高+1 (到楼板面); 层高3 -> 4, 层高4 -> 5; 每步升1格, 踏步数=floors

material.notes: any minecraft:*_stairs; 平台/梯腹填实自动推导同系整砖 (木-> planks, stone_brick-> stone_bricks ...)

railing.notes: 扶手: 梯段外缘与踏步同高的 fence/wall (贴邻踏步); 平台边缘不装 (室内平台靠墙)

railing_material.notes: 空=自动推导 (木-> 同种 fence, 石-> 同种 wall, 无对应 wall 时 fallback cobblestone_wall/iron_bars)

underside.notes: true=梯腹填实到地面; false=踏步下留空做储物 (踏步逐级互承, L/U 平台柱仍填实, 不悬空)
